claims.supporting_quote: Next to it is a dummy die occupying 21 mm², used for the structural integrity of the package. Beside it is another 18A-P silicon die that functions as a peripheral control tile, measuring 58 mm². This configuration includes a compute tile, which hosts a 4P+8E-core configuration on the Intel 18A-P node, occupying 55 mm² of area.
